description: This CSS file defines styles and variable themes for a React application. It includes light and dark theme configurations, styling for various components, and keyframe animations for the application logo.

classes.name: theme-toggle
classes.description: A button class that toggles the theme between light and dark modes. Styled with various CSS properties for appearance and transitions.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application class that centers content and applies background and text colors based on the current theme.

classes.name: App-header
classes.description: Class providing styles for the application's header, including layout and color adjustments based on the theme.

classes.name: App-logo
classes.description: Class for the logo element, including animation effects.

classes.name: App-link
classes.description: Class for links within the application, styled with color adjustments based on the theme.
